name: paranoidal-power-districts
title: Paranoidal: Power Districts
author: Paranoidal
description: Transformers T-40...T-320 split the base into districts. Keep a district's load in the green zone (90-110 % of the nominal) and the transformer gives it 6-12 % more energy than it takes. Priorities, load shedding, reserve, taps and an on-load tap changer, short overload, load bank, power meter, circuit signals and a Dispatcher window.
